rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a small amount; use it for a small number only when the context makes that clear.

example.english: This soup only needs a smattering of salt.
example.traditional: 呢啲湯落少少鹽就夠喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 tong1 lok6 siu2 siu2 jim4 zau6 gau3 laa3

rows.note: Use this instead of 少少 when the smattering is a small number of countable people or things.

example.english: Only a smattering of people stayed behind after the meeting.
example.traditional: 個會議完咗之後，得幾個人仲留低。
example.jyutping: go3 wui6 ji5 jyun4 zo2 zi1 hau6 dak1 gei2 go3 jan4 zung6 lau4 dai1

rows.note: Use this for shallow or superficial knowledge, as in knowing only the basics of a subject.

example.english: I only know a smattering of programming.
example.traditional: 我對編程只係識啲皮毛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 pin1 cing4 zi2 hai6 sik1 di1 pei4 mou4
